pages.useful_because: The homepage is the only page that puts all eight Rock'n G services side by side with the client's own job photos (trench excavation, under-floor drain lines, a garage softener and filter install, gas piping to a standby generator, a finished kitchen remodel), and it carries a symptom board that maps what a homeowner notices (hot water running short, crust on faucets, several drains gurgling, a warm spot on the floor, soggy yard patches) to the likely cause and the Rock'n G service that handles it, plus a gas-smell safety note. It also states the verified facts in one place: Eli Gomez as Responsible Master Plumber on Texas license M-44822, three generations, 20+ years, Mon–Fri 8–6 hours, free estimates, military discounts, and the Tom Green County towns served.
